summary: The math module has square roots, rounding, pi, and more. Import it once at the top of your program.
notes: import math is required. Then you call functions as math.sqrt(), math.ceil(), and so on.
math.ceil(47 / 40) is 2 because it always rounds up.
abs(), round(), min(), and max() are built in, so they work without import math.
pitfall: Calling sqrt(144) without math. in front raises NameError: name 'sqrt' is not defined.
